global_authority.rule: All annual cooldowns and once-per-day receipts use monotonic game.day_epoch() across 56-day years.
Single idempotent transaction ledger owns debits, refunds and resource transfers across all 20 concepts.
Exclusive NPC reservations and consent are checked before Builder/Emergence activities.
Daily water and crop state are authoritative; building capture and regional habitat only consume agreed bounded summaries.
Domain states roundtrip via assembled game save; previews have no side effects and receipts are replay-idempotent.
Construction placement and canoe route queries use stable world coordinates and revisioned occupancy, without unapproved valley edits.

overlaps.title: Roof cisterns versus regional watershed
overlaps.authority: Construction owns roof geometry and finite cistern water ledger; Emergence owns river segments, habitat, fish migration and catch limits.
overlaps.interface_contract: Farming hydrology exports immutable daily runoff; water transferred to cistern is debited from a single rainfall source.
overlaps.invariant: A rainfall event cannot credit both roof cistern and river without partition; daily inflow equals cistern capture plus ground runoff plus loss.
overlaps.acceptance: Native two-year rainfall replay with roof and river adapters must prove partition and save/load conservation.

overlaps.title: Construction crews versus community chores
overlaps.authority: Construction owns project sites, material debits and builder payroll; Emergence owns nonconstruction NPC chore commitments and results.
overlaps.interface_contract: Village owns NPC schedule, consent and fatigue; both request exclusive time-slot reservation through Village.
overlaps.invariant: One NPC cannot perform a paid build shift and harvest chore in the same exclusive time slot; wage and reward receipts idempotent.
overlaps.acceptance: Simultaneous crew and chore requests resolve deterministically with no duplicate wages or tasks.

overlaps.title: Room comfort versus private letters
overlaps.authority: Construction owns room topology, privacy and warmth; Emergence owns letter provenance, confidential promises and delivery state.
overlaps.interface_contract: Village alone owns NPC relationships and permission to enter private spaces; letters may query privacy status read-only.
overlaps.invariant: Room comfort cannot create a promise or override consent; private letters cannot change structural geometry.
overlaps.acceptance: Consent withdrawal, room relocation and letter replay must preserve confidential state and valid NPC routes.

overlaps.title: Climate homes versus world event director
overlaps.authority: Construction owns insulation, maintenance, weather wear and repair costs; Emergence owns general causal event eligibility and consequence journal.
overlaps.interface_contract: Principal provides authoritative weather/day_epoch; event adapter may request bounded damage through Construction command gateway.
overlaps.invariant: No duplicate storm damage, no hidden mutation on preview and no unbounded daily activation cascade.
overlaps.acceptance: Repeat seeded storm day with save/reload and event replay; one repair receipt and one weathering receipt.

overlaps.title: Climate homes versus evolving rituals
overlaps.authority: Construction owns home thermal/weather response; Emergence owns community rituals and participation consequences.
overlaps.interface_contract: Village owns festival dates, NPC invitations and consent; Emergence ritual may query house readiness read-only.
overlaps.invariant: No automatic housing modifications from ritual participation; annual fixed festivals remain authoritative.
overlaps.acceptance: Two-year winter house-warming ritual cannot trigger twice or change house structure without a build command.

overlaps.title: Architectural blueprints versus textile patterns
overlaps.authority: Construction owns structural graph templates and bill-of-materials; Emergence owns bounded textile motif grids and dye recipes.
overlaps.interface_contract: Inventory owns fabric and wood material debit; template catalog IDs are typed and namespaced.
overlaps.invariant: Textile motif import must never instantiate building components or mint materials; blueprints remain plans, not resource containers.
overlaps.acceptance: Cross-type import rejects invalid template with unchanged inventory and persisted state.

overlaps.title: Terrain foundations versus canoe routes
overlaps.authority: Construction owns foundation footprints and terrain protection; Emergence owns boat route graph and dock travel commands.
overlaps.interface_contract: Valley owns canonical water geometry and occupancy; both request read-only geometry revision.
overlaps.invariant: New foundation cannot silently block all accessible boat routes or modify a protected farm plot; invalid placement returns reasons.
overlaps.acceptance: A shoreline pier plan is rejected or adapted when it would eliminate all safe mooring routes.

overlaps.title: Salvage refunds versus caravan trades
overlaps.authority: Construction owns salvage provenance, dependency-safe demolition and recoverable component quality; Emergence owns finite caravan inventory and trade escrow.
overlaps.interface_contract: Principal inventory/economy service is sole authority for item ownership and currency; caravan may only trade already-minted salvaged goods.
overlaps.invariant: No duplicate refunds after demolition, no sale of pending salvage and no negative escrow during delayed caravan settlement.
overlaps.acceptance: Replay demolition plus caravan trade twice and verify exact conserved material, gold and receipt IDs.

phase_gate.phaseA: Twenty documented concepts and eight explicit overlap contracts; joint mechanical tests required, then Principal acceptance before expansion.
phase_gate.phaseB: After explicit Phase-A acceptance, Builder EB-B-011..110 and Emergence EB-E-011..110 add 200 fully scoped unique ideas.
phase_gate.phaseC: Only after all 220 specs pass review and exact-head evidence, begin prioritized native Godot gameplay implementation.
